reason: Document B makes it much harder for me to dismiss the association as just a few loud complainers by explicitly pointing out that two-thirds of the building signed the petition and by framing their first two requests as reasonable, zero-cost actions compared to the $400,000 elevator. Document A stretches the facts with emotional assumptions about August and reads more like a standard laundry list of demands, whereas Document B is tighter, fairer, and offers a clear public-relations incentive to respond.
